notes: SD Tokenomics changed in June 2024, where it reduced the total supply to 120M by doing 30M burn.
Private Sale unlocks between 0-5% at TGE, we assume it unlocks 5% at TGE and linearly vests 36 months post TGE

Rewards & Farming releases are governance-determined. Per Stader docs, ~10.99M is unlocked vs ~35.51M remaining at the docs snapshot; modelled here as linear monthly emissions over 10 years from TGE to approximate that pace.
Ecosystem & DAO is governance-determined and may unlock at any moment per Stader docs, we marked it as TBD.

Ecosystem & DAO (TBD).methodology: 13.75% of supply allocated for governance-determined initiatives. Per Stader docs, tokens may be unlocked at any moment.

Ecosystem & DAO.methodology: The unlocked portion of the Ecosystem & DAO allocation.
